_doc: Acquisition-cascade fixture from the dapagliflozin HFmrEF/HFpEF review (2026-09-27): one article (McMurray et al., Circulation 2024) reporting TWO trials, DETERMINE-Preserved and DETERMINE-Reduced, plus a combined exploratory analysis. Regulatory routes skipped: the trials' results are not in an FDA/EMA/NICE document.
